=={{header|Cxc}}==

Compare code points from both ends until the pointers meet. Early-exit through dispatch guards: if a pair differs, the atom ends in the fail phase; if the pointers cross, it ends in the success phase.

<syntaxhighlight lang="elixir">
def main:
    use console: Console
    text: String! = "racecar"

    -> running
        self :> check(0)

    running <: check(i: Int):
        |:  i * 2 >= self.text.length() -> end
            console.write("palindrome")
        |:  self.text.code_at(i) != self.text.code_at(self.text.length() - 1 - i) -> end
            console.write("not palindrome")
        |?: -> running
            self :> check(i + 1)
</syntaxhighlight>
